scope: Selected public summaries from MCP memory and the experiment atlas, checked against saved source identities before publishing. A published snapshot, not live access to private notes. Dates are sharing dates for notes and run dates for experiments; date-only precision.

entries.title: Where should a team of agents commit to a decision?
entries.summary: Comparing sequential pipelines, routing, orchestrator/workers, parallel candidates, debate and population search.
entries.detail: The screenshot groups architectures by where alternatives are discarded. The next question is whether extra agents help a paper task enough to justify their cost. No architecture comparison has been run. Jason supplied the article URL as the source; the full article was not accessible for independent verification.
entries.next_check: Compare a single-agent baseline with one motivated alternative under the same task and request budget.
entries.source_label: The Return of the Designer · source supplied by Jason

entries.title: Extracting methods, models and datasets from papers
entries.summary: Considering a PyTorch token classifier that keeps exact source spans and caches annotations when a paper is opened.
entries.detail: Start by auditing public datasets and label definitions. PyTorch is the initial runtime candidate; ONNX or TensorRT would need a measured bottleneck and output-equivalence checks. The shared post’s latency target is not our benchmark result.
entries.next_check: Choose a licensed dataset, inspect labels and establish a simple extraction baseline before training.

entries.title: Qwen fine-tuning: reliable execution versus useful answers
entries.summary: On 40 selected QASPER questions, error-free episodes rose from 18/40 to 39/40 after SFT.
entries.detail: Both checkpoints received supported-answer passes on 3/20 answerable questions in model-assisted review. The 44 demonstrations were teacher-seeded and include AI repairs. This measures the selected development workload, not general paper-research quality.
entries.next_check: Audit stopping decisions and false refusals before proposing another training run.

entries.title: A small GRPO pilot and its limits
entries.summary: The restarted pilot completed nine verified optimizer updates; rollout collection timed out before update ten.
entries.detail: A separate exploratory comparison found one complete supported answer in each arm on ten clear-reference questions. Sparse within-group reward differences and a small evaluation limit what can be concluded. The checkpoint was not promoted.
entries.next_check: Improve reviewed training signal and evaluation design before spending on another RL run.
